title: Cause & Effect
grammar: Causal connectors emiatt and aminek következtében; compound and possessive nouns
goal: I can say that one thing leads to another with emiatt and aminek következtében.
I can build and spell compound nouns such as klímaváltozás and szén-dioxid-kibocsátás.
I can talk about climate with four new words, such as üvegházhatás and ökológiai lábnyom.
I can say what climate change causes.
